versions.changelog:
opc-ai-ip-protection v1.0.0 – Initial release

- Provides a legal framework to protect AI technology outputs and establish asset ownership for Skills/Agents.
- Offers mapping between traditional IP rights (trademark, copyright, patent, trade secret, data IP) and corresponding AI assets.
- Includes templates for asset-specific IP records and risk assessment.
- Recommends prioritized IP protection actions: urgent, important (applicable for IP), and long-term planning.
- Highlights relevant industry standards and upcoming regulatory changes.
